title: 第5章 紫雷神典天地异象第6章 这异象不会是林凡弄的吧
slug: 九叔系统道术给我全加满
content_zh:
雷霆升至上空，缓缓停下！
书本周围缠绕着数道狂暴的紫色雷电。
仿佛要将靠近之物都摧毁一般。
那耀眼的紫色雷芒，让林凡心底不由得产生一股敬畏和恐惧。
忽见四个通体透亮，金光熠熠的大字，位于书籍上空——【紫霄神典】！
【叮！扣除宿主50点功德，五雷咒已优化为紫霄神雷！】
“紫霄神雷？！”
林凡心中呢喃，未等作出反应。
只见，天空乌云密布，雷鸣四起。
一道道紫雷划破夜空，仿佛要撕裂苍穹一般。
轰！
一道充满灵气的恐怖紫色光束。
一闪而过，向林凡天灵盖直直而下散开来。
那可怖的惊人速度与数量，比以往修炼之时都要精纯都要庞大。
“要突破了？”
无数道精纯且庞大的灵气向房间内袭来。
仿佛此间所有灵气都向林凡汇聚势要将房间挤破开来。
林凡不敢怠慢。
心神守一，屏息凝神。
虽然前些时日也隐隐感觉要突破后天六重了。

碍于如今道法世界灵气如此稀薄。
不曾想在系统升级道法之下还有如此效益。
【系统提示：恭喜宿主已突破至后天六重】
【系统提示：恭喜宿主已突破至后天七重】
此刻林凡周身气息强大了数倍。
整个人都容光焕发，仿佛经历了上苍的洗礼一般。
这些年间卡在瓶颈久久不能突破，不想觉醒系统后竟如此变态。
优化精进功法之余，还能随着功法的提升境界也得以突破。
感受突破后的气息林凡一阵欣喜。
“系统，打开属性面板！”
【属性面板已打开！】
姓名：林凡
境界：后天七重天
法器：桃木剑（道术增幅100%）
道法：紫霄神雷（入门）、镇魂符（大圆满）、清心符（大圆满）
技能点：3674
功德：0
……
“无敌了！”
林凡看着属性面板的紫霄神雷，眼睛一亮。

紫霄神雷只是入门，那就说明还能继续升级！
要知道，这入门境界的紫霄神雷，可就比五雷咒强悍得不止十倍！
这要是提升到大圆满，简直不敢想！
content_en:
The thunder rose to the sky and slowly stopped!
There were several violent purple lightnings surrounding the book.
It seems to destroy everything that comes close.
The dazzling purple light made Lin Fan feel a sense of awe and fear in his heart.
Suddenly, I saw four large characters that were bright and golden, located above the books - [Purple Sky Divine Code]!
【bite! After deducting 50 points of merit from the host, the Five Thunder Curse has been optimized into the Purple Sky Divine Thunder! 】
"Purple Sky Divine Thunder?!"
Lin Fan murmured in his heart before he could react.
I saw that the sky was covered with dark clouds and thunder was everywhere.
Purple thunder streaked through the night sky, as if it was about to tear the sky apart.
boom!
A terrifying purple beam full of aura.
It flashed past and spread straight down towards Lin Fantian.
The terrifying and astonishing speed and quantity were purer and larger than before during cultivation.
"A breakthrough?"
Countless rays of pure and huge spiritual energy attacked the room.
It was as if all the spiritual energy here were converging on Lin Fan, trying to squeeze the room open.
Lin Fan did not dare to neglect.
Keep your mind focused and hold your breath.
Although a few days ago, I had a vague feeling that I was going to break through the sixth level of acquired skills.
Because the spiritual energy in the Taoist world is so thin nowadays.
I never thought that there would be such benefits after upgrading the system.
[System prompt: Congratulations to the host for breaking through to the acquired sixth level]
[System prompt: Congratulations to the host for breaking through to the seventh level]
At this moment, the aura around Lin Fan became several times stronger.
The whole person was radiant, as if he had experienced the baptism of God.
I have been stuck in a bottleneck for a long time and have been unable to break through. I didn't want to be so perverted after awakening the system.
In addition to optimizing and improving the skills, one can also achieve breakthroughs as the skills improve.
Feeling the aura after the breakthrough, Lin Fan was overjoyed.
"System, open the properties panel!"
[The properties panel has been opened! 】
Name: Lin Fan
Realm: Seventh Heaven the Day After Tomorrow
Magical weapon: Peach wood sword (Taoist skills increased by 100%)
Taoism: Purple Sky Divine Thunder (Introduction), Soul-Calming Talisman (Great Perfection), Pure Heart Talisman (Great Perfection)
Skill points: 3674
Merit: 0
…
"Invincible!"
Lin Fan looked at the Zixiao Divine Thunder on the attribute panel and his eyes lit up.
Zixiao Divine Thunder is just a starter, which means you can continue to upgrade!
You know, the Zixiao Divine Thunder at this entry level is more than ten times more powerful than the Five Thunder Curse!
If this were to be elevated to Dzogchen, I would simply not dare to think about it!
